tf62a562f: Understand energy used by small devices
t5f059c25: Many small electronic devices are used every day without us thinking about their energy consumption. Mobile phone chargers, wireless routers, tablets and security cameras often operate for long periods or even continuously.
te7553867: Although each device consumes relatively little energy, their combined impact can be significant over a year.
tef9f8a50: Energy consumption depends on both power and time.
t07466978: Devices such as routers and security cameras may operate 24 hours a day throughout the year. Continuous operation can result in surprisingly high annual electricity consumption.
td8e36acc: Smart charging habits and efficient devices can reduce energy use while maintaining the same level of comfort and connectivity.
tada0c6a4: While one router may not seem expensive, multiple always-on devices can noticeably increase household energy consumption.
